_comment: Copy this file to config.json next to AutoDoc.exe and fill in the fields below. config.json is gitignored on purpose — never commit real API keys.
_provider_comment: provider: 'anthropic' uses the Claude API (needs api_key + claude_model below). 'local' uses any OpenAI-compatible local vision server (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) — narration and blurred screenshots never leave the machine/network. Switching providers requires no code changes.
